assessment: This article puts forward a new approach to generate vascularized brain organoids. The novelty of their approach lies in the simultaneous production of vessel-like networks and brain-resident microglia immune cells in a single organoid, and data demonstrating that the vessels are patent to allow fluid flow when pressurized fluid is delivered to the vascular tube. The fusion of brain and vessel organoids resulted in robust engraftment of vessel-like structures and microglia around ventricular zone-like structures, correlating with increased neuronal progenitors.
